official.deadline_central_display: Sunday 28 February 2027 (round one); round two Sunday 16 May 2027
official.deadline_note: Two application rounds: round one closes Sunday 28 February 2027 with notification of success by 2 April 2027; round two closes Sunday 16 May 2027 with all applicants notified by 11 June 2027. Applications remain under consideration until all scholarship awards have been allocated, and eligible applicants not selected in round one may be considered again in later rounds.
official.status_note: Applications for September 2027 taught Master's courses open on 1 October; offer holders are notified by email with details of how to apply when the scholarship application form is available.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The scholarship is paid as a fee reduction for your first year of study only and can only be used as a fee reduction; it cannot be used towards other costs, including maintenance or accommodation costs.
benefits: Can be combined with the Masters International Regional Scholarship or external funding as long as the total does not exceed 100% of tuition fees
May also be combined with a School or Faculty scholarship, subject to those schemes' terms
eligibility: Classified as an international student for fee purposes
Hold a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible full-time taught Masters course starting in September 2027
Demonstrate an excellent academic track record, predicted to achieve or having achieved a minimum of a Bachelor's degree with a 2:1 (hons) or equivalent
Show excellent professional and personal skills evidenced through work experience and/or extracurricular activities
Excluded courses: the MBA (which runs its own MBA Excellence Scholarship) and all fully online courses
requirements: Hold a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible course before applying
Submit the University of Leeds scholarship application form after receiving the offer notification by email
Demonstrate excellent professional and personal skills through work experience and/or extracurricular activities
documents: University of Leeds scholarship application form (submitted after the admission offer)
Evidence within the application of work experience and/or extracurricular activities supporting professional and personal skills
selection_criteria: Recognition and reward of high academic achievement
The final scholarship awarded to an applicant is determined by the University and all decisions are final
coverage: Tuition fee discount of £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 on the first year of study only
Cannot be used towards maintenance or accommodation costs
application_method: Wait for the email to offer holders with details of how to apply when the scholarship application form is available
Submit the scholarship application form; a separate application is required for each course if you hold offers for multiple courses
official.application_route: Hold an offer, then submit the Leeds scholarship application form when offer holders are emailed the details - separately for each course.
official.citizenship_residency: Classified as an international student for fee purposes
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Eligible full-time taught Masters courses; MBA and all fully online courses are excluded
official.description: The University of Leeds offers a substantial number of Masters International Excellence Scholarships worth £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 to support eligible international students applying to taught Masters degrees starting in September 2027. The awards recognise and reward high academic achievement and are paid as a tuition fee discount on the first year of study only.

verification.notes: Official University of Leeds scholarship page fetched in full: £3,000/£6,000/£16,000 values, international fee status, 2:1 requirement, self-funded or partially-funded condition, MBA and fully online exclusions, 1 October opening and the 28 February 2027 and 16 May 2027 round deadlines all verified verbatim.

applicant_utility.summary: You cannot apply for this scholarship until you hold a Leeds offer, and you must submit a separate scholarship application for each course you hold an offer for - applicants with multiple offers who file once quietly lose consideration on the others. The award is a first-year tuition discount of £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 with the final value decided by the University, so treat £16,000 as the ceiling rather than the expectation. Round one on 28 February 2027 is the better target since unsuccessful round-one applicants roll into later rounds anyway, and note that the money cannot touch maintenance or accommodation - you still need a full living-cost plan.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International fee-status applicants with a 2:1-equivalent record and a Leeds taught Master's offer for September 2027, who are self-funded or partially funded and can evidence work or extracurricular achievement.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure your conditional or unconditional offer, then watch for the offer-holder email explaining how to apply when the form goes live on 1 October
Submit a separate scholarship application for each course you hold an offer for
Gather evidence of work experience and extracurricular activities, since professional and personal skills are an explicit criterion
Check your course is not the MBA or a fully online programme before investing time
common_rejection_risks: Applying before holding an offer - the form is only available to offer holders
Holding multiple offers but submitting only one scholarship application
Assuming the award is renewable or applies to later years - it is a first-year-only fee reduction
Being UK fee-status classified, which excludes you from this international scheme
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, accommodation and travel are fully the student's responsibility; the award only discounts first-year tuition and cannot exceed 100% of tuition when combined with other funding.
document_audit: The scholarship application form arrives via the offer-holder email - monitor the address on your application and your spam folder
If combining with the Masters International Regional Scholarship or external funding, verify the total stays at or below 100% of tuition fees
alerts: The scholarship cannot be deferred to the following year and is non-transferable to other Leeds courses
Through an International Partner Agreement you may accept only one University of Leeds scholarship - the highest-value one
Round-one applicants hear by 2 April 2027, but applications stay under consideration until all awards are allocated, so silence is not rejection
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission offer first; the University emails offer holders when the scholarship form opens on 1 October; one application per course; outcomes by 2 April 2027 (round one) or 11 June 2027 (round two).
